findings.label: CloudFront shared prefix-list origin exposure
findings.detail: The EC2 security group opens port 80 only to the com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing managed prefix list (no SSH, no 0.0.0.0/0 ingress), which satisfies the step's accepted bar. That prefix list is shared by all CloudFront tenants, so another tenant's distribution could route to the origin on port 80; the app's JWT auth still gates /api. Optional hardening (not required by the accepted design): have CloudFront send a secret custom origin header and reject requests lacking it.
